title: Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant
scope: Standing public-facing exterior of Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, with the New Safe Confinement arch and the adjoining long industrial hall and main visible building volumes.
limitations: This is an exterior landmark model. The silver shell follows the plant operator’s published dimensions. The hall cladding, roof joints and smaller visible volumes are approximate.
The 2018 ground photograph shows the installed exterior arch. The model represents its standing roof envelope and simplifies localized subsequent changes to cladding and surface conditions.
The model covers the central standing buildings. The commemorative sculpture, distant construction, canals and separately mapped outlying facilities are outside scope.
